item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.14

  • Changing Music Mode's poster background in Settings now changes the poster straight away.
  • Between songs, the Music Mode button, the volume bars and the playback line keep the last album's colour until the next cover arrives, instead of flashing grey.
  • The player's icon in the notch now follows Music Mode's colour as it changes, instead of keeping an old one.
  • The volume bars are white when Music Mode is off, and in the album's colour when it's on.
  • The menu bar menu no longer shows keyboard shortcuts that went to other apps.
